name: CM32_unknowns_are_observation_obligations
origins: AnyPS5 AGENTS.md (never return a made-up success)
statement: A gap whose semantics no card derives is classified by what would close it and never filled with a made-up success: console-specific behaviour (names, signatures, layouts, error codes, timing) is closed only by observation (Pheros L102), boundaries (hardware, services, DRM) are named, and only what a public standard or the model's own structure fixes is derived, with a witness.
